scope: Private operational planning from fixed inputs and retained elapsed/evaluation counts only. No gain, fitted parameter, or score outcome used; no execution/source change.

proposal.kind: Finite per-case allocation, not a replacement runtime prediction or proof of completion
proposal.allocation_rule: Round up to a whole minute: twice the largest dense pilot case time; four times the largest broad pilot case time. Explicit finite allowances, not a calibrated prediction or assurance of completion.
conditions: Preserve the old failed projection and every accepted report, trace and index byte.
Explicit independently reviewed operational gate amendment; no claim old projection passed.
All75 remaining cases in frozen order; no gain-based choice/reorder/replacement.
Every fit retains original8 starts, bounds, tolerances, quadrature and gates.
A case exceeding its finite batch cap is retained as unresolved partial and stops progression; no automatic retry or cap increase.
Budget charges all actual attempts including failures, plus original failure exactly once.
Unused slot time is not silently converted into larger later case caps.
Sampled RSS6GiB,2threads,1worker,2GiB headroom and hard run expiry unchanged.
One-case batch makes each wall allowance enforceable by existing supervisor without modifying case scientific code.
